text:
deploy-bot: Created new release tag v2.3.0 (commit a7f3c2d) and pushed artifact 4829 -> staging. Change window: 30m starting 2025-10-12 18:00 UTC. Diff: https://git.redwood/inference/compare/a7f3c2d..HEAD

Emma K: Quick summary for the release notes?

deploy-bot: Release notes digest (short):
- perf: KV-cache sharding to reduce tail latency (~-12% P95 on long chats)
- perf: fused attention kernel reduces GPU memory usage (~-6%)
- fix: embeddings truncation when input > 64k tokens
- infra: safer model swap logic to avoid duplicate warmups

Raj P: Re: Dedicated pools — recommend holding `--quantize=int8` off for prod until post-validation. Also pin model to `redwood-ggml-v1.2` for this rollout.

Linh T: Kicked off pre-prod smoke: `./scripts/smoke.sh v2.3.0 --env=staging`

Linh T: smoke results: 12/12 checks ✅. Latency within expected bounds.

deploy-bot: Canary plan created: 10% for 15m -> 50% for 30m -> full. Canary route: `canary-2.3.0`. Rollback command: `redwoodctl rollback --to-tag v2.2.7 --env prod`.

Maya C: Heads up — integration partner maintenance window at 18:30-19:00 UTC, might affect downstream queues. Please ping if we see unusual error spikes.

Emma K: Please run the conversation regression eval set before canary. Pin request for prod will be made after canary metrics look good. @Linh can you run evals?

Linh T: Running evals now (conversation-regression). ETA ~18m. Will post results.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy finished at 1765000600. Tag refs/tags/v2.3.0 created. Artifact: s3://redwood-releases/4829.tar.gz

Linh T: Evals done — diffs within tolerance for intent/fluency; no major regressions. Recommend proceed to canary.

Raj P: I'll be on-call during the rollout. If anything spikes above thresholds, I can cut the rollback.

Emma K: :thumbsup: starting canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary 10% started at 1765001200. Monitors: latency_p95, error_rate, cost_per_token, throughput. Dashboards: https://console.redwood/d/rollout/v2.3.0

deploy-bot: Canary progressed 10% -> 50% at 1765001400. No regressions detected in key signals.

Maya C: Integration queues look clear on our side. No downstream alerts.

Emma K: Proceeding to full rollout.

deploy-bot: Full rollout completed at 1765001800. Tag v2.3.0 promoted to prod. Release notes pinned in #eng-releases and linked to the release artifact. :tada:

deploy-bot: Ops note — to pin Dedicated pools/customers to a previous tag: `redwoodctl pin --pool <pool-name> --tag v2.2.7`. For urgent rollback: `redwoodctl rollback --to-tag v2.2.7 --env prod`.
